name: World Director (Local)
tagline: Observe, record, and direct a mini AI town — local-Executa edition.
description:
World Director (Local) is an experience-type Anna App. Users open it in Anna chat to observe and intervene in a mini AI town where a handful of residents live, interact, and evolve.

**What's inside**

- A static single-window UI (CSS Grid map + timeline + director panel).
- `truman-director` — a bundled Python Executa that ticks the world and persists it to Anna Storage. Every tick, agent actions come straight from the host LLM via host sampling, requesting structured JSON with a text-mode compatibility fallback when the host explicitly rejects json_schema — no rule engine.
- This is the Executa-based edition: the town engine runs as a process on the selected Anna Agent. That Agent must be online and have the bundled truman-director tool deployed. Windows Local Agent has been tested; Cloud Agent deployment is still under review.
